title: Client–server lifecycle: follow a real request
description: Trace an HTTP request through routing, processing, response handling, and error recovery using a real local server.
objectives: Describe the request and response lifecycle
Identify methods, paths, headers, bodies and status codes
Implement and exercise a JSON endpoint in Node.js
Distinguish HTTP error responses from connection failures
rubric: I inspected successful and failed requests in the Network panel.
I completed the starter and passed its acceptance tests.
I demonstrated that fetch resolves for a 404 and checked response.ok.
